from.description: Where the task must stand for this to count. Null is wherever it is.

stationIds.description: Every station on the line, left to right

color.description: Six digit hex. The board offers a palette, but any will do.

description.example: Where new work lands before anyone looks at it

harness.description: The harness to work this run. Only runners that have it may take it.

spec.description: Handed to the runner untouched: checkouts and cwd. The command is filled in from the harness, so it is not given here.

targetRunnerId.description: Runner this run belongs to. Omitted lets any runner with the harness take it.
The runner it waits for, or null for whoever is free

executable.description: What to look for on the runner’s PATH.

keys.description: The workspace directories this runner should still be holding. Anything else under its workspace root has nothing left to resume and may be disposed of.

capacity.description: What the runner advertises. The control plane grants work.

harnesses.description: The harnesses the runner found installed. What is on a machine is a fact about that machine, so the machine is what says it.

spec.description: Opaque to the control plane, meaningful to the hook

body.example: Cap the retries at 500 while you are in there.

upTo.description: Everything said up to and including this note was given

body.description: Markdown, shown as the pull request description

resolve.description: Resolve the thread as well as answering it

next.description: The station to pass the task to, or "review" to ask a person. A name this line does not know is treated as a question for a person.

note.example: Reproduced on restart. Needs a spec for draining the queue.
note.description: What the next station, or the person, should know

sessionId.description: What the harness called this conversation. Reported rather than remembered by the runner, because the next run may fall to another one.

form.description: What it shows, which is not what it did

voice.description: Who spoke: the station, a person, or the world outside it

stationPosition.description: Its place in the line, from zero

runId.description: The run that wrote it, whose journal it came from

body.example: Reproduced on restart. Needs a spec.

author.description: Absent where the station said it rather than a person

id.description: One conversation a person was asked to own

stationPosition.description: Its place in the line, from zero

stationCount.description: How many stations the line holds

raisedAt.description: Where it was raised, which it keeps as it moves

standsAt.description: Where the task stands now, which is where it ended up

resolved.description: True once it is settled, and is no longer yours to answer

working.description: True while a run is working it, so an answer is coming

unread.description: Something was asked here that they have not seen yet

briefing.description: What the station that opened this conversation was given

body.example: Drain the queue before retrying, and cap it at 500.
body.description: What the person says back. It joins the task’s trail.

after.description: The file as the agent left it

tool.description: What sort of tool it was: execute, read, edit, …

detail.description: What the tool answered with, as much of it as is worth reading

ms.description: How long it took, in ms

startedAt.description: When it began, for laying the run out against a clock

given.description: What the tool was asked for, as it was asked

readyAt.description: When the workspace was handed to the agent

spans.description: Empty for a harness that reports nothing of itself

ms.description: How long the run spoke for, in ms

readable.description: False for a run from before the agents spoke a protocol

lastSeenAt.description: Null when the runner has never connected

revokedAt.description: When its token was retired, if it has been

connected.description: Heard from recently enough to be counted on

currentRun.description: The run it is working on, or null when idle

name.description: What to call this runner. Rejected if empty or over 60.

token.description: Shown once. Nothing can recover it after this response.

fullName.description: Named the way GitHub names it, owner and all

installationId.description: The installation GitHub named when it sent you back

deliverTo.description: Where this host should be told to send its deliveries

secretSet.description: Whether the workspace has set it. Never its value.

repository.description: The repository this team reads its configuration from. Null takes the pin off.

where.description: The page in Spotlight this step is taken from, or null where there is none

summary.example: Move a task on when its issue is done.

chosen.description: Whether this team already listens to it

connectedToGitHub.description: The App has to be installed to read or write

sources.description: The hosts this team uses, by the name each is known by

dropped.description: The hosts it no longer uses, whose files the change removes

name.description: What the configuration calls it. Never its value.

value.description: Written once and never read back out of Spotlight.

told.example: The pull request was commented on.

conversationId.description: The inbox conversation waiting on a person

body.example: The run was given up on after 3 attempts.

awaitingReview.description: Where a standing question is answered, or null for none
